The operational flight plan on the phone: times, weights, fuel, the route with SR
and levels off the form's own headings, the package's weather and NOTAMs, and the
charts.

**This build is unsigned.** Apple will not install an unsigned app on a device
directly — sign it with your own Apple ID first, with AltStore or Sideloadly on
your own machine. See `ios/README.md`.

The app is also a web page: <https://rbozzhanov-web.github.io/Iphone-OFP-viewer/>
installs to the home screen from Safari and needs none of this.
